description: Telnyx model-provider plugin for Hermes Agent — OpenAI-compatible inference, hosted open models + frontier routes

summary.one_liner: A Telnyx-maintained model-provider plugin that lets Hermes Agent use Telnyx's OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint for hosted open-weight and frontier models.
summary.what_it_does: Adds Telnyx as a provider inside Hermes Agent through the external model-provider plugin surface, so it lives outside the hermes-agent tree. It exposes OpenAI-compatible chat completions with streaming, tool calling, and usage reported on the final chunk. The model list is pulled live from the authenticated /v2/ai/openai/models endpoint and filtered to text-generation models, including open-weight models hosted on Telnyx GPU infrastructure (Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Qwen, Llama) plus proxied frontier routes. When the live catalog cannot be reached, it falls back to a curated, tool-call-verified list. The installer prompts for TELNYX_API_KEY and stores it in the Hermes env file.
use_cases: Use Telnyx-hosted open models inside Hermes Agent
Run Kimi, GLM, MiniMax or Qwen models through one API key
Switch Hermes to a Telnyx model with the interactive picker
Add an OpenAI-compatible provider to a Hermes setup
Test tool-calling agents against hosted open-weight models
notable: Live model catalog fetched from the authenticated Telnyx /models endpoint, with curated offline fallback
Registers through Hermes's documented external provider plugin surface (providers.register_provider)
Intentionally sets no default output cap, because max_tokens with function tools triggers Telnyx error 10015 on some hosted models
Optional live pricing test validates exposed models against the Telnyx catalog before release
caveats: Requires Hermes Agent 0.21.4 or newer for correct per-million-token price normalization
Model list requires a valid TELNYX_API_KEY; anonymous requests get 401 and show only the fallback list
Restarting long-running hermes gateway processes is needed after install because discovery runs once per process
